item.title: La tragedia de Jesús de Miguel y las consecuencias para Jesús Owono
item.description: El mundo del fútbol sigue conmocionado por la muerte del delantero español Jesús de Miguel, tras un choque durante un partido con el guardameta Jesús Owono, del FC Andorra e internacional con Guinea Ecuatorial. El portero, expulsado durante el encuentro, podría enfrentarse a una sanción deportiva de hasta 12 partidos, mientras la Policía investiga las circunstancias del fallecimiento. Pero más allá de las posibles consecuencias disciplinarias y judiciales, la tragedia plantea otra cuestión: ¿cómo afrontar el impacto psicológico de verse involucrado en la muerte de un compañero de profesión?… Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: 'Incredible achievement for the family' as Bellingham brothers called up
item.description: It may be a surprise to some but Jobe Bellingham's call up to the England senior side has been a long time coming. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Fly-half Smith fit to steer England against Wallabies
item.description: Fly-half Fin Smith recovers from a calf injury and will start for England in their opening Test of the autumn against Australia on Sunday. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: England secure group top spot with Ireland win
item.description: England beat Ireland 68-32 to secure top spot in Pool A and book their place in the Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup semi-finals. They will face co-hosts Australia on Tuesday, after completing the group stage with a 100% record. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Women's rights matter more than any league, say Afghan cricketers
item.description: Afghanistan Refugee Women's cricket team players express disappointment foreign players have signed up for the country's franchise league. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Westwood worried for DP World Tour after LIV collapse
item.description: Former world number one Lee Westwood expects the PGA Tour to "play hardball" with its European counterparts following the demise of LIV. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'It would be pretty special' - Chessum on England captaincy links
item.description: Ollie Chessum says that he relishes being an on-pitch leader after being tipped as a long-term successor to England skipper Maro Itoje. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: RFU boss confirms WRU Anglo-Welsh league approach
item.description: RFU chief executive Bill Sweeney confirms the WRU has officially asked to join an Anglo-Welsh league, although no talks have taken place. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Two-year ban for 'Clicky Ponting' cricketer
item.description: An amateur cricketer is banned for two years for his role in the ‘Clicky Ponting’ cheating scandal that made headlines across the globe. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Has Anderson lived up to the hype after Man City move?
item.description: As Elliot Anderson returns to Nottingham Forest after his £116m move to Manchester City, has he lived up to the price tag? Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Palmer misses too many chances to impress - Tuchel
item.description: England manager Thomas Tuchel says Cole Palmer "misses too many chances to impress" after not selecting the Chelsea forward for November's Nations League fixtures. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Permane to stay as Racing Bulls team principal
item.description: Red Bull extend Alan Permane's contract as boss of their second team until the end of 2031. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: McIlroy fires 63 to move into Abu Dhabi contention
item.description: Rory McIlroy recovers from the setback of being penalised two shots in his opening round at the Abu Dhabi Championship by firing 11 birdies in a nine-under-par 63 in round two on Friday. Fuente: BBC Sport.
